TFDL_POST: We're seeking two additional members for our panel at the 2026 Media Studies Conference hosted by Poplar College. Please email jmiles@poplar.edu if interested.
Panel title: Rethinking Documentary—Collaboration and Authorship

Panel description: This panel explores ways to involve participants in documentary production beyond traditional observation. Historically, filmmakers have controlled the narrative, leaving little room for those on camera to shape their own stories. We'll discuss methods for working directly with participants to ensure accuracy and trust, providing strategies for scholars and practitioners interested in building stronger partnerships with the communities they document.

Academic Rationale: Recent scholarship emphasizes participatory and community-driven practices as a response to long-standing concerns about representation and authorship. By examining strategies for collaboration, this panel contributes to debates about ethics and methodological innovation in documentary research and production.
Confirmed Participants: Jordan Miles (Moderator), Poplar College; Taylor Chen, Summit University.
